evidence: The current KiCad physical authority and generated Gerber Job declare ENIG and black top/bottom solder mask.
config/requirements.json and config/product-decisions.json require JLCPCB SMT assembly for the first prototype.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities/: fabrication capability depends on the selected solder-mask color and process.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/Capabilities?type=1 lines 201-202: multilayer 1 oz minimum track/spacing 0.09/0.09 mm.
https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/Capabilities?type=1 lines 217-218: SMD pad-to-pad minimum 0.15 mm; the reviewed 0.20 mm board default preserves margin for USB-C fine pitch.
config/jlcpcb-impedance-evidence.json: JLC04161H-3313A USB pair uses the manufacturer-calculated 0.290576 mm base width and 0.2032 mm gap over In1.Cu.

usb_connector_fanout.scope: Connector-side J1-to-U2 nets only; never applies after U2.

open_0p20mm_vias_near_smt_pads.component: All open 0.20 mm drill vias, including the 18 unique vias whose drill area intersects an SMT paste-bearing pad
open_0p20mm_vias_near_smt_pads.reason: The exact adopted board has 20 vendor-style PIN-to-hole intersections representing 18 unique same-net open vias. They are electrically safe but ordinary unfilled construction can wick solder; JLCPCB states that vias in pads or less than 0.35 mm from pads require epoxy or copper filling rather than ink plugging.

u1_thermal_holes.reason: Gerber and Excellon cannot prove that the 12 under-module holes receive the intended anti-wicking treatment. Confirm the order/CAM treatment before release.

notes: Selection records provenance only. Run apply_reviewed_fab_values.py after independent review before real routing.
The listed 0.20 mm default is a manufacturability rule, not an approval for high-current power copper. Power-net geometry requires its own reviewed current-capacity evidence.
